description.value: The Rockwater Grill & Bar is a full-service restaurant and entertainment venue in Golden, BC, with both a riverside patio and a rooftop patio along the Columbia Valley. It bills itself as the region's premier nightlife spot, hosting weekly live music spanning folk, punk rock, DJs, and comedy in a 360-person room. Touring cyclists finishing a day at Kicking Horse or in the Rockies will find a broad menu of hand-crafted food and cocktails in a lively, welcoming atmosphere.
